capabilities: Read and modify files, run shell commands, inspect images, and manage background processes.
description:
Search file contents with regular expressions (ripgrep).

- Use full regular-expression syntax and pass the pattern without surrounding quotes.
- Respects .gitignore.
- Only filter by type or glob when you are sure of the file type.
- Output is ripgrep-style and large results are capped.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match.

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match.

-C.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match.

glob.description: Glob pattern used to filter files, such as '*.ts'.

head_limit.description: Limit output to the first N lines. Defaults to 200.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode, where patterns can span lines. Defaults to false.

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the workspace path.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents.

type.description: File type to search, such as js, py, rust, or go.

name: grep
